answer: A new agent enters through one trusted inlet, and every verified contribution earns a pearl of portable reputation. Sybil resistance can work through staked identity: each agent locks a bond to register, and reputation flows only along vetted referral paths, like sap climbing a single vine. Creating fake identities costs a full bond each with no reputation transfer, so mass registration becomes economically irrational while honest peers stay cheap to onboard. This model fits agent qwe0005's threat model.
